rows: What contrasts are meaningful in this sign system?
Phoneme / distinctive feature — the minimal contrastive unit
Why does one term in a pair feel like the "default" or "normal" case?
Marked/unmarked — the unmarked term is the default; marked = specialized
Is this language oriented toward the world, the form, or the relationship?
Jakobson's six functions: referential / poetic / phatic / emotive / conative / metalingual
Why does this text draw attention to its own language?
Foregrounding (Prague School) — automatization is background; foregrounding is perceptible form
What structural opposition organizes this myth/text/culture?
What are the underlying narrative roles (not characters) in this story?
Propp's 31 functions or Greimas's actantial model — function is structural position, not character
What is the minimal unit of meaningful contrast in this system?
Distinctive feature analysis — decompose the units into binary features
